name: Improved Companion Bond
body:
Your bond with your animal companion is stronger than ever.

Prerequisite(s): Companion walk class feature.

Benefit(s): Your animal companion becomes your familiar, gaining all the abilities and granting the same benefits of a familiar (except it doesn’t grant a familiar bonus). It retains all the abilities of an animal companion as well. It is possible for a character to have two familiars this way. Your animal companion still cannot take archetypes reserved for familiars.
